stated_objective_pain_point: Demonstrate MBSE methodology applied to a CubeSat mission.
Provide a CubeSat Reference Model that teams can use as a starting point for mission-specific CubeSat models.
Develop the CRM as an OMG specification.
Reduce burden of systems-engineering tasks for small CubeSat teams and promote uniformity/consistency.
mbse_objective_scope_artifacts.system_boundary_level_of_abstraction: CRM covers CubeSat Mission Enterprise, external environment/constraints, stakeholders, space segment, ground segment, CubeSat subsystems, ground station services, and transport/launch/deploy services. Logical components are abstractions of physical components and avoid implementation constraints; physical architecture is created during mission-specific tailoring.
mbse_objective_scope_artifacts.deliberately_minimal_or_excluded: Other services (e.g., GPS, TDRSS) are not explicitly modeled in the CRM unless important to a specific mission. Power/EPS is only modeled at subsystem level. External transport/launch/deploy and ground station services can be modeled as provided services rather than developed by the CubeSat project.
mbse_objective_scope_artifacts.required_prior_behavioral_domain_knowled: Authors assume intermediate understanding of space mission analysis/design, MBSE, and SysML, plus SME guidance; the CRM provides a starting framework rather than requiring zero prior knowledge.

key_findings_relevant_to_RQ1: Strongly relevant example of a SysML CubeSat reference model/template that generalizes mission, enterprise, space/ground segment, subsystem, requirements, behavior, and V&V concepts.
Provides a mission-specific tailoring pathway from reference logical architecture to physical architecture and development, but assumes intermediate MBSE/SysML/domain knowledge and SME support.
key_findings_relevant_to_RQ2: Claims reuse/reproducibility, traceability, consistency/uniformity, reduced effort burden, stakeholder alignment, and mission assurance benefits at system level.
No EPS-specific reliability/reproducibility/integrability evidence and no quantitative/empirical outcome evaluation.
key_findings_relevant_to_RQ3: Describes system-level pre-physical V&V concepts: viewpoints as objective evidence, representative mission population, V&V scenarios, and possible mission scenario execution.
Does not provide EPS-specific verification procedures, acceptance criteria, test cases, HIL/SIL, or power-system simulations.
limitations_gaps_stated_by_authors: CRM validation/verification and external evaluation are future work.
Model elements for stakeholder needs, objectives, technical measures, use cases and requirements are still being added.
Adoption assumes intermediate space/MBSE/SysML understanding and SME guidance.
